root.description: The id of the root the path is under

config.description: The demanded config the compilation is of, relative to its root; null for a root-level row

path.description: The file holding the reference the condition is about, relative to its root; null for a root-level row

ordinal.description: The reference's `ts_imports` ordinal in the file; null for a root-level row

code.description: `TS_OUTPUT_REDIRECT_AMBIGUOUS`: an output path of the config's output map has two sources (two configs, or `x.ts` and `x.tsx` in one config), so a reference resolved to it is `unresolved`; the row is at that reference and `message` names both sources; `TS_VERSION_SKEW`: at least one workspace manifest declares a `typescript` of a major other than the one VAT answers with; a root-level row, with null `config`, `path` and `ordinal`

message.description: What the condition found; for TS_OUTPUT_REDIRECT_AMBIGUOUS it names both sources

pinnedMajor.description: The major of the TypeScript VAT answers with, read from the loaded module; for TS_VERSION_SKEW; null for every other code

declaredMajors.description: The distinct majors the workspace manifests declare, ascending, comma separated; for TS_VERSION_SKEW; null for every other code

manifests.description: How many manifests declare a major other than `pinnedMajor`; for TS_VERSION_SKEW; null for every other code

projection-ts-import-conditions.description: A row of the derived `ts_import_conditions` relation: a finding about the resolved graph that is a value, not a registry finding code; the step never refuses on it
